w: After Swamishri's morning puja a collective program for home-visit (samuh padhramani) was arranged. Devotees who had enrolled came up to Swamishri, placed a flower before Thakorji and received the blessings of Swamishri and 'prasad' from the senior sadhus. The collective home-visit is a great service to Swamishri because it saves him from physical strain.

The stage decoration for the Children's Day program was set in a traditional Vedic atmosphere. Children chanted Vedic mantras and recited stories in the form of a discourse. The discourse was interlaced with drama presentations of stories of a Guru and his disciple students, Nachiketa and Yamraja and the child who conquered his mind and offered a melon to Shriji Maharaj. Children chanted the Purush Sukta shlokas with appropriate mudras.
Finally, Swamishri discoursed on the need for parents to inspire their children into Satsang and studies.

On the previous day, 17 August, Swamishri departed from Atladra at 3.00 pm by car to Amdavad. Since the flight to Bangalore was late Swamishri departed at 6.15 pm and landed at Bangalore airport at 10.00 pm. After nearly three years Swamishri was visiting Bangalore again. In the evening welcome assembly today the Deputy Chief Minister of Karnataka Shri Yediruappa, Minister of Science and Technology Shri Ramchandra Gauda and MLAs Shri Narendra Babu and V. Somnna garlanded Swamishri.

Viveksagar Swami elaborated upon the story of Nishkulanand Swami from the Harililamrut. Thereafter youths performed a welcome dance. Finally, Swamishri blessed the assembly with the message of pricelessness of human birth and its principal aim to attain God and not to engage oneself in mundane pleasures.

The evening satsang assembly was themed ‘Trust – the World’s Breath’. When Swamishri arrived in the assembly the kishores performed a welcome dance. After a kirtan related to youths, a poem on trust was read. In conclusion Swamishri blessed all, “In this world ( samsar ) one studies and attains material progress, but this does not help one at the time of death and to attain God’s divine abode. For that one needs to have trust in God – that he is the all-doer. It is because of him that all things are accomplished. Today we find that all countries of the world have progressed. And we believe that this progress achieved is due to our planning, effort and research. But if one thinks profoundly then one will find that it is due to God that everything is accomplished. The reason is because he resides within us. He resides in all, in all living things – this trust one must develop in life.”
From today a seven day parayan was beginning on the occasion of Pramukh Swami Maharaj's passing to Akshardham.

For this, Mahant Swami Maharaj came to the "Yagnapurush Sabha Mandap". Here, after darshan of Thakorji, as he did every time, he went to sit on the sofa of the senior sadhus, placed to the left of Swamibapa's image. Seeing this, the attendant sadhu came quickly to him and, leading Swamishri towards the seat arranged in the centre, said, "Swami! This seat is for you. You are now the guru. Now you are to sit here..."
Accepting the attendant sadhu's request, he sat in the centre.
Even after becoming guru, Swamishri had not the slightest awareness of being guru. What a matchless guru!

At the start of the parayan held on the occasion of Pramukh Swami Maharaj's passing to Akshardham, giving blessings, Mahant Swami Maharaj said, "Recently everyone came and went in a hurry; so if anyone was discourteous or anyone was hurt, please forgive. Gunatitanand Swami has said, 'Behind each sadhu, lakhs and lakhs of people will follow...' Then what will the situation be? Since Swami said it, it is going to happen. If there is not the least human perception of God and there is a sense of divinity, then there will be joy in listening to this katha. In the Bhaktachintamani, Nishkulanand Swami has written the words, 'We have seen him, seen him eating, seen him lying down...' These are words of direct experience. Where is the elephant and where is the ant? If the ant doubts the elephant, how can they match? It cannot even see it. If someone crushes a laddu and feeds it to an ant, how great a grace that is? (Likewise) God has met us in human form; otherwise, who would care for us? Because there are flaws and shortcomings in us, we see (human traits in God). This is not about God up above; this is about God in person."
Today was the holy festival of Raksha Bandhan. On this occasion, giving blessings, Mahant Swami Maharaj said:

"Shriji Maharaj has pulled us out of the ocean of misery. Here it is a matter of becoming brahmarup from a jiva. If we think about it, we have found something truly great. Now there is a great need for unity. For unity we will have to wear ourselves out. It is not a matter of wearing out others. Pramukh Swami Maharaj gave the formula for unity: tolerate, wear yourself out, give up what you like, and adjust. This is the supreme formula. If we live like this, everything is included.

"We are to carry forward the work of Shastriji Maharaj. The more we join in that work, the more we benefit. That work will go on; it is not going to stop. My only prayer is that we become very wise and join in it."
